name: Rose City Golf Course
architects: George Otten (1923; first nine played 1922 on the old Rose City Speedway site)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth; newest project at the course OLC_METRO_3DEP_2019, also OLC_METRO_2014), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 531000-533000 / y 5042400-5043500, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-rose_city)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), same box and date
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

scorecard_source: Third-party (no card on the city's site found): stymie.golf's Blue Tournament card (par, handicap, yardage per hole; 71.0/120), read 2026-11-13; GolfPass (course 11365) has the same yardages for every tee set (its 'Tournament' row) and the other rows in scorecard.csv. The front-nine stroke indexes differ between Stymie (used) and GolfPass (7,3,15,13,17,1,9,5,11). Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto (checks only): Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Tournament) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; inland Pacific Northwest wind 1-7 mph; trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme rose_city (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1399 x 522 m, relation/6549434) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (196 m west/east, 123 m south/north)
